svg.title: Thrills & Chills — curved concept G: Golden hour lights

g.font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Shapes and colours of A, lit by a low evening sun from the
left: warm lit faces, cool blue shade sides, long soft shadows.
Ride bulbs, lamp and stall window glow. A day/night preview.
